sql: WITH committed AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND status IN ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled')), snap AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp, quantity::numeric) AS qty FROM positions ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) SELECT 'A_realized_0910' AS what, COALESCE(strategy,'-') AS k, to_char(COALESCE(SUM(pnl),0),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text AS v FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Emmsell10','Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4') AND closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-10 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'B_cumulative_since_arm', strategy, to_char(SUM(pnl),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4') AND closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'C_live_open_by_cap_rule', 'STILL OPEN vs bound 40', count(*)::text FROM committed c LEFT JOIN snap s USING (market_ticker) WHERE s.qty IS NULL OR abs(s.qty) > 0.01 UNION ALL SELECT 'D_live_orders', COALESCE(status,'?'), count(*)::text||' last='||to_char(max(created_at),'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'E_integrity_err', e.kind||' '||COALESCE(x.key,'?'), to_char(e.detected_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI')||' resolved='||COALESCE(to_char(e.resolved_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI'),'NO') FROM experiment_integrity_events e LEFT JOIN experiments x ON x.id=e.experiment_id WHERE e.severity='error' AND e.resolved_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'F_last_scan', to_char(max(created_at),'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), count(*)::text||' cycles in 2h' FROM system_events WHERE component='mmsell_scan' AND created_at > now() - interval '2 hours' ORDER BY 1,2
